card_suoyituan.png:
A cartoon illustration for a card game, landscape composition, showing a grey tabby cat ninja in action.

TWO THINGS SHARE THE FRAME, and BOTH must be large:
1. THE BIG OBJECT - fills roughly 50% of the picture, rendered in DEEP INDIGO BLUE: an enormous thick
   quilted futon blanket, rumpled and puffy, wrapped up and over into a cocoon
2. THE CAT - fills roughly 40% of the picture, drawn EXACTLY like the cat in the attached reference sheet.
   COPY THE REFERENCE'S PROPORTIONS. This is the part that keeps going wrong, so be strict about it:
   - The head is BIG and ROUND - roughly as large as the whole body. Do not draw a small head.
   - The eyes are LARGE and ROUND with big dark pupils. Do not draw narrow slit eyes.
   - The muzzle is TINY, the body is short and chubby. Do not stretch the body out or make it look like a
     real cat's anatomy. It is a chibi mascot, not a realistic animal.
   - Same grey tabby markings, same navy headband with two trailing tails, same thick black outline,
     same flat colouring, same navy ninja outfit as the reference.
   Draw it big enough that its face reads clearly when the picture is shrunk to 150 pixels wide.
   The cat and the big object must overlap and clearly interact - the cat is doing something TO or WITH the
   object, never just standing beside it.
   What the cat is doing: curled up into a tight ball inside the blanket with only its head and one paw peeking out, eyes squeezed shut, bracing itself against a hit

The cat: light grey tabby fur with dark grey stripes, white chest and paws, narrow half-lidded eyes,
a NAVY BLUE ninja headband with two trailing tails, a dark navy ninja outfit with a dark belt, long ringed tail.

FILL THE WHOLE FRAME. The picture is shown inside a short, almost-square window on the card, so a wide flat
composition wastes most of it. Do NOT stand the two elements side by side in a horizontal row with empty bands
above and below them. Instead overlap them and spread them into the corners so that the drawing reaches the top
edge, the bottom edge and both sides. The cat should be roughly as tall as the picture, not a short figure
sitting on the baseline.

Bold and readable at thumbnail size: strong silhouette, high contrast, no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
The whole picture should read at a glance from its dominant colour and its overall shape.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour. Nothing may be transparent, translucent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.
Output 1024x820 PNG. Save the image as card_suoyituan.png in the current directory and report the path.
event_catnip_field_take.png:
A single scene illustration for a story event in a cute cartoon roguelike card game, landscape composition.

Scene: the grey tabby cat ninja standing in a field of lush purple catnip, having just grabbed a big
armful of the plants and stuffing them into the front of its ninja coat, cheeks bulging with a pleased
guilty grin, a few loose leaves still floating in the air around it

THE CAT: draw it EXACTLY like the cat in the attached reference sheet.
Copy the reference's proportions - this is the part that keeps going wrong, so be strict:
big round head roughly as large as the body, large round eyes with big dark pupils, tiny muzzle,
short chubby body, thick black outline, flat colouring, navy headband with two trailing tails, navy ninja outfit.
Do NOT draw a realistic cat and do NOT stretch its body out.

Tell the story in one readable picture: clear staging, strong silhouette, expressive face.
It will be shown about 420 pixels wide, so no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon storybook look,
not photorealistic.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no user interface, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying - draw only the
cat and the catnip it is holding, standing on nothing.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as event_catnip_field_take.png in the current directory and report the path.
